texts.summary: Louis-Sauveur, marquis de Villeneuve to Jean Otter, 29 June and 19 August 1737. French commercial and diplomatic plans in Persia, including an approach to Chah Nadir and a consul at Ispahan; reports of Ottoman, Russian and Imperial military affairs. The June letter repeats the commercial instructions and discusses Otter’s journey, oriental languages and political work.
